decks.notes: The deck focuses on aggressive creatures that can quickly deal damage to the opponent while also utilizing blink effects to protect key threats or gain advantage in combat. By blinking creatures like Quantum Riddler or Overlord of the Balemurk with cards like Ephemerate or Flickerwisp, the deck can avoid removal spells and create powerful board states. Thoughtseize and Fatal Push provide disruption and removal, while cards like Solitude and Teferi, Time Raveler offer additional protection and utility. The deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with its aggressive creatures and disruptive elements.

The deck focuses on using artifacts and cheap creatures to create a fast and aggressive playstyle, aiming to overwhelm opponents quickly. It utilizes cards like Mishra's Bauble, Mox Opal, and Emry, Lurker of the Loch to generate mana and card advantage. The inclusion of Metalcraft cards like Cori-Steel Cutter and Metallic Rebuke helps to maintain board control and protect key pieces. The deck also includes removal spells like Unholy Heat to deal with threats and Tamiyo, Inquisitive Student for card draw. Overall, the deck aims to put pressure on opponents early and maintain a strong board presence.

The deck revolves around using Allosaurus Rider as a powerful combo piece to quickly ramp into big creatures like Griselbrand and Ghalta, Stampede Tyrant. It utilizes Neoform and Eldritch Evolution to tutor for key pieces and generate advantage. Consign to Memory helps with card draw and disruption. The deck aims to quickly assemble its combo pieces while having protection in the form of Pact of Negation and Veil of Summer. Overall, the strategy focuses on explosive plays and efficiently closing out the game through powerful threats and synergistic interactions.

The main concept of this deck is to utilize the powerful combo between Cosmogoyf and Necrodominance to quickly ramp up Cosmogoyf's power and bring it out onto the battlefield. The deck includes various cards to help control the opponent's hand and disrupt their strategy, while also featuring cards like Soul Spike and Rite of Consumption for additional burst damage. The deck aims to win the game through a combination of efficient removal, hand disruption, and explosive damage output from Cosmogoyf.

This Boros Aggro deck focuses on quickly deploying aggressive creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Guide of Souls to pressure opponents. It also includes disruptive spells like Prismatic Ending and Mana Tithe to control the board. The deck utilizes cards like Goblin Bombardment and Ocelot Pride for additional reach and board presence. Ajani, Nacatl Pariah serves as a powerful finisher, while cards like Ranger-Captain of Eos provide utility and flexibility. The deck aims to overwhelm opponents with a fast start and efficient threats, while disrupting their game plan with removal and disruption spells.

This deck focuses on using the Broodscale Bloodchief combo to generate tokens and pump them up with Blade of the Bloodchief to overwhelm opponents. It also utilizes Yavimaya, Cradle of Growth to accelerate mana production and Urza's Saga to tutor for key pieces. Malevolent Rumble and Kozilek's Command provide removal and disruption while Emrakul, the Promised End serves as a finisher. The deck aims to establish board presence quickly and close out games with a powerful swarm of creatures.

The main concept of this deck is to utilize a toolbox of creatures to create a powerful combo engine. By using cards like Green Sun's Zenith and Finale of Devastation to search for key creatures such as Devoted Druid and Walking Ballista, along with Leyline of Abundance and Nature's Rhythm to generate mana, players can quickly assemble game-winning combos. Agatha's Soul Cauldron can also be used to recur creatures from the graveyard, providing additional value and resilience to the deck. Overall, the deck aims to efficiently assemble its combo pieces and overwhelm opponents with powerful synergies.

This deck focuses on utilizing artifacts and control spells to disrupt the opponent's game plan while generating value and card advantage. It aims to control the game through countering spells, removing threats, and manipulating the board state. The deck also includes powerful planeswalkers like Teferi and Tamiyo to further control the game. By leveraging cards like Urza, Mox Opal, and Mishra's Bauble, the deck can generate mana and card advantage to pull ahead in the late game while maintaining control throughout the match.

The main concept of this deck is utilizing the discard effects of cards like Burning Inquiry and Faithless Looting to quickly fill up the graveyard with creatures such as Hollow One, Vengevine, and Detective's Phoenix. By aggressively dumping creatures into the graveyard, the deck aims to quickly flood the board with powerful aggressive threats, overwhelming the opponent with a fast-paced, explosive playstyle. The inclusion of cards like Marauding Mako and Lightning Bolt provide additional removal and reach to close out the game efficiently.

The deck revolves around creating a powerful board state by utilizing cards that generate tokens and buff creatures. It also includes various control elements to disrupt the opponent's strategy. The key strategy involves playing Eldrazi creatures and using cards like Devourer of Destiny and Blade of the Bloodchief to grow them to overwhelming proportions. The deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a mass of powerful creatures and disrupt their game plan with removal and hand disruption.

The deck utilizes a toolbox of creatures to generate mana and tutor for key combo pieces. It focuses on ramping up mana with cards like Devoted Druid and Leyline of Abundance to quickly bring out powerful creatures like Craterhoof Behemoth and Ouroboroid. Tyvar, Jubilant Brawler and Badgermole Cub provide additional value and utility, while Green Sun's Zenith helps search for specific creatures when needed. The deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a combination of strong creatures and efficient mana generation.

The main concept of this deck is to control the game through the efficient use of powerful artifacts and Eldrazi creatures. By assembling the UrzaTron lands (Urza's Tower, Urza's Mine, Urza's Power Plant), the deck can generate a large amount of mana to cast game-changing spells like Ugin, Karn, and All Is Dust. The deck also utilizes disruptive cards like Thought-Knot Seer and Chalice of the Void to disrupt the opponent's game plan, while using cards like Devourer of Destiny and Glaring Fleshraker to apply pressure on the opponent.

The deck focuses on assembling a toolbox of creatures that can be searched for and played using Green Sun's Zenith. By generating mana with Leyline of Abundance and Devoted Druid, the deck can quickly ramp into powerful finishers like Craterhoof Behemoth. The inclusion of Agatha's Soul Cauldron and other utility creatures like Eternal Witness and Vizier of Remedies allows for flexibility and resilience in the face of disruption. The deck aims to efficiently combo off and overwhelm the opponent with its versatile creature interactions and explosive plays.

This deck focuses on utilizing a combination of cards that work together to quickly generate advantage and overwhelm the opponent. By strategically playing cards like Chthonian Nightmare and Village Rites to draw additional resources and using cards like Warren Soultrader and Voice of Victory for extra power, the deck aims to set up a winning board state efficiently. Gravecrawler and Marionette Apprentice offer extra synergy with the rest of the cards, while the land base is carefully constructed to support the combo-centric strategy.

This deck focuses on utilizing creatures with enter-the-battlefield effects to control the board and apply pressure on the opponent. By repeatedly blinking creatures with cards like Ephemerate and Flickerwisp, you can generate value and disrupt your opponent's game plan. Cards like Teferi, Time Raveler and Thoughtseize help to further control the game and pick apart your opponent's hand. The deck also includes removal in the form of Fatal Push and Prismatic Ending to deal with threats. Overall, the deck aims to outvalue and outpace the opponent through aggressive creature interactions and disruption.

This Boros Aggro deck focuses on aggressive plays with efficient creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Guide of Souls, supported by removal spells like Galvanic Discharge and Prismatic Ending. The deck also uses Goblin Bombardment for additional reach and pressure. The mana base includes fetch lands to ensure consistent color fixing. Ajani, Nacatl Pariah provides a powerful anthem effect to pump up the team, while cards like Voice of Victory and Fable of the Mirror-Breaker offer card advantage and utility. The deck aims to quickly overwhelm opponents with a fast and efficient creature-based strategy.
